title: Localize workflow signals and replayable benchmarks
description: Extend the existing dependency-free LocaleCatalog with one typed runsWorkflow section for the two remaining analytical panels on /runs: Workflow signals and Replayable benchmarks, including WorkflowCohortCard and only the helpers they own. Keep en-US as the only production-selected locale. The new section must cover both panel titles and descriptions; outcome, correction and known-cost labels and sentences; natural singular/plural wording for runs, rounds, requests and responses; terminal-sample, incomplete-run, human-attention, provider-hold, median-time and configuration wording; latest-cohort and previous-baseline labels; empty and single-cohort guidance; and both no-score/observational disclaimers. Reuse the existing runsOperational executor/reviewer role labels and the shared API-equivalent expected-cost meaning instead of creating competing terminology. Format workflow USD through the explicit Locale and make wall-time wording locale-owned. Keep workflow revisions, provider ids, model names and effort values verbatim. Preserve summarizeWorkflow and summarizeWorkflowCohorts, the bounded latest-50 replay, the latest-two adjacent cohort selection, ordering, arithmetic, raw factual comparison, absence of a composite score or causal claim, and the existing closed disclosure behavior. Thread Locale plus runsWorkflow only through WorkflowInsightsPanel, WorkflowBenchmarkPanel, WorkflowCohortCard and their formatting helpers. Do not translate the shared ContextPanel open/close affordance in this slice because changing every route would exceed the boundary; en-US remains the sole production locale and pt-BR remains internal and unselectable. Extend the existing static-render tests in place with one explicit pt-BR /runs fixture that exercises both analytical panels, locale-specific USD, pluralization, wall time, role labels, cohort guidance and raw revision/provider/model/effort preservation, while retaining the existing en-US assertions and the explicit proof that no score is introduced. Do not add snapshots, wording-regex gates, dependencies, endpoints, tables, settings, browser inference or persistence. Update HANDOFF.md only to record the stable post-merge phase: shell, conversation and all /runs product-owned panel content are internally localized; /work, /settings and onboarding remain before any selector. Preserve its resilient header, history and approval boundary. Out of scope: a visible locale selector, shared ContextPanel affordances, /work, /settings, onboarding, server/client status messages, notifications, orchestrator prompts, database or lifecycle behavior.
